findingDetails.title: The packet's ledger, acceptance evidence and task state are unwritten at HEAD
findingDetails.case: Every packet completion artifact is still scaffold state: implementation-summary.md says Nothing yet with no ledger and no Tests table, all nine acceptance-criteria rows read Unmet, T012 to T014 are unchecked and every goal completion box is unchecked, while the commit range touches no packet file.
findingDetails.evidence: implementation-summary.md:48 and :62; acceptance-criteria.md:54-62 (AC-005 at :58); tasks.md:59-61; goal.md:60-65; git diff --name-only 41302e72be..HEAD -- <packet> is empty.
findingDetails.userImpact: REQ-005 (P0 in spec.md) and SC-001 evaluate false; the packet cannot close; per-row proofs are unfindable; AC-004 is marked Unmet although its own command passes.
findingDetails.scopeProof: spec.md fixes the ledger location (The builder records every row above in implementation-summary.md); no second PV-R1..R8 ledger file exists.
findingDetails.claim: The reviewed commits leave the packet completion record unwritten, so the shipped state cannot be traced to a closed ledger.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Packet diff over the range (empty); later commit holding the ledger (HEAD is the release commit); waiver or decision-record.md (neither exists); per-row proofs in commit messages (only per-commit Verification blocks).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Phase 3 (T012-T014) may be recorded only after this review completes; the evidence exists but not in the designated artifact.
findingDetails.confidence: high on observed state; medium on closure-timing intent
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A recorded post-review closure step that owns the ledger/AC fill, or the fill itself (then P2).
findingDetails.recommendation: Fill the ledger and Tests table from the commit evidence, set AC statuses from observed runs, check off T003-T014, or record the deferral before the packet is represented as complete.

findingDetails.title: The 22-doc frontmatter addition is not traceable to a recorded amendment of frozen decision D1
findingDetails.case: D1 excludes docs with no frontmatter block (21 hand-authored docs listed in spec.md) and spec.md says adding frontmatter to them is not in scope and is an operator call; commit 18d3233a52 adds a frontmatter block and version 1.0.0.0 to 22 such docs with no amendment recorded in the packet.
findingDetails.evidence: git show 18d3233a52 = 22 files, 161 insertions; 22/22 parents frontmatter-less; rg -ni amend|operator over the packet finds no amendment; goal.md table and log unchanged; no decision-record.md; only the commit message asserts operator intent (with spec.md:62's related 2026-10-12 intent).
findingDetails.userImpact: The frozen decision record contradicts shipped behavior; authorization lives only in a commit message; the changelog does not record the addition either.
findingDetails.scopeProof: One commit, one decision record; the other out-classes were not touched by this addition.
findingDetails.claim: The addition of frontmatter to 22 docs contradicts D1 as recorded, with no in-packet amendment.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Packet-wide amendment search (none); decision-record ADR (none); all 22 parent trees (frontmatter-less).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The operator may have authorized it via the 2026-10-12 intent; the substance matches that intent, so only the record lags.
findingDetails.confidence: high that no record exists; medium on authorization
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None needed at P2; an operator confirmation closes it as a documentation fix.
findingDetails.recommendation: Record the amendment in goal.md or a decision record naming the 22nd doc and cite it from open question 1; or revert 18d3233a52.
